name: delivery-meeple-v1
description: ⭐ THE DELIVERY MEEPLE AS DEAN RULED IT ON 12/09/2026 (M1 to M8, ledger A151, section 5 of docs/village-store-coins-2026-09-12-v2.md): a random meeple sits on every tile's 3 VP delivery space (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, index 1 and never index 0), claiming that receipt claims the meeple, and AFTER your main action you may discard ONE meeple to take the PLAIN action of its colour (rules.turn.meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', rules.turn.meepleSpendPerTurn 1). The meeple then leaves the game. rules.turn.meepleSpendDistinctColours stays false, which is the rule as ruled; the alternative is overlays/delivery-meeple-distinct-colours-v1.overlay.json and it is C112. ⛔ ITS CONTROL IS overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json AND EVERY ONE OF THAT ARM'S TWENTY LEAVES IS PINNED HERE BY NAME. This file differs from the control in exactly three meeple leaves; the six coin leaves are pinned at their shipped-off values so the Village Store cannot ride in as a passenger. ⛔ C100 IS STILL OPEN AND NO NOTICE BOARD ARM IS RULED IN AS THE SHIPPED GAME: the shipped default is rules.turn.visitCurrency 'commons', so THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM and every report header quoting it must say so. The seat-shaped host draw is only the best-performing configuration measured (5 PASS / 1 FAIL / 11 OBSERVE), not a ruling. ⭐ PROVENANCE, AND IT OUTRANKS EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE: DEAN PLAYED THIS AT A TABLE ON 11/09/2026 AND LIKED IT. His report was that it allowed some fun, powerful combos. ⭐ WHY IT EXISTS: THE ISLAND HAS NO DECISION IN IT. Every tile is mechanically identical, no levels and no ascending VP, so the only island choice is 'take 6 before 3' and it is the same every time. A random reward on the second space makes taking second a real choice whose value changes over the game, AND IT RESTORES THE ONLY CATCH-UP TERM THIS DESIGN EVER HAD, deleted with the island's seed meeple on 09/09/2026 and never replaced. ⛔ IT IS NOT THE MEEPLE THAT DIED AT A TABLE ON 09/09/2026 AND THERE IS A NUMBER FOR THAT: second deliveries are 37.5% of receipts and players make about 4.7 deliveries a game, so this mints roughly 1.8 meeples per player per game, each EARNED by taking second at a tile, where the rejected version seeded FIVE PER PLAYER at setup and the complaint was precisely that the bonus was always available. Two earned, scarce, visible tokens is a different economy wearing the same component. ⚠️ THE FIRST NUMBER TO READ IS ACTIONS PER TURN, which passes at only 1.61 against a target of 1.5 and to which every meeple spent adds an action. Then meeples minted, spent and STRANDED at game end, and the colour mix of what was spent. ⚠️ AND THE ARM REVERSES THE REASON THE BONUS SITS AT THE FRONT: the bonus was moved to the start of the turn on Dean's own reasoning that a turn visibly ends on the main action (C2, 09/09/2026), and a spend after the main action means the turn ends on a bonus again. Mild, because most turns will have no meeple to spend, but it is a direct tension with a deliberate ruling and it is a teach cost rather than a number. ⛔ THE COLOUR MAPPING IS M7 AND IT IS GROW AND NOT SOW: wheat buys Harvest, vegetable buys Deliver, orchard buys Draw 2 keep both, apiary buys GROW, dairy buys Build. Sow is not a core action, and orange meaning one thing in one place and another elsewhere has cost this project a day before. ⛔ AND IT IS THE PLAIN ACTION AND NEVER THE NOTICE BOARD POWER (M6): the Orchard board is Draw 4 where the plain action is Draw 2, and the two stopped being the same thing on 10/09/2026. ⭐ M8: A MEEPLE GROW PLACES ITS ACTIVATION CARD AS NORMAL AND CAN CLOG, unlike a coin-Grow. The two new rules differ there on purpose, and this arm carries the clogging half. ⭐ THE BUILDER DEFAULTS THIS ARM CARRIES, NAMED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED, because on 05/09/2026 an arm built for one purpose carried three unnamed knob changes and ruling it in ruled all four. D7 ⭐ RULED BY DEAN, 12/09/2026: THE MEEPLE SPEND IS LEGAL ON ANY TURN ONCE THE ACTION WINDOW HAS CLOSED, whether the main action was taken or passed. D8: the meeple's plain action IS subject to the standing rule that an action you cannot legally perform is not offered, which has survived every currency this game has had, AND IT MEANS A MEEPLE CAN BE UNDISCARDABLE. Read the stranded count with that in mind: a meeple stranded because its action was never legal is a different finding from one stranded because its owner never wanted it. ⚠️ D1 to D6 have no subject in this arm because there is no coin, and D9, whether the meeple's Deliver mints coins, has no subject either; it needs overlays/village-store-coins-and-meeple-v1.overlay.json, which is C111. ⛔ WHAT MAY NOT BE QUOTED OFF THIS ARM. (1) THE BONUS RATE IS A SHARE OF TURNS AND NEVER PLAYS PER TURN. Judging the band on plays cost this project a re-run of five arms on 09/09/2026, and the bonus slot at four seats has one tenth of a point of headroom under the control, so this is the arm where the wrong measure would be most expensive. (2) NO LEVEL HERE IS COMPARABLE WITH A reference-v14 OR EARLIER NUMBER; only a delta paired on identical seeds against the named control is sound. (3) THE BARN GLUT READS +0.5 IDENTICALLY ACROSS THIS WHOLE FAMILY ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES, so read the per-seat rows and NEVER the pooled median. (4) The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none, so nothing here is evidence about hand tightness in either direction. (5) ⛔ NOTHING HERE ANSWERS C112. This arm is the cap of 1; the combo burst Dean's table enjoyed is measured by its sibling and not by this file. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME. THIRTY LEAVES. The control's twenty, unchanged and in its own order: rules.turn.visitCurrency, bonusTiming, selfVisitAllowed, hostDrawOnVisit, commonsTake, startingMeeplesPerColour, meepleAsCard, slotToll, meepleCapPerColour; rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, noticeBoardBlocks, unclaimedBoardsToCentre, noticeBoardsBySeats.2, .3 and .4, commonsColourMatch, commonsWildPair, endgameCoinCost, farmsteadCoinPower; and rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4. ⛔ NOTE rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour STAYS 0 AND rules.turn.meepleAsCard STAYS false. THIS ARM'S MEEPLES COME FROM THE ISLAND AND FROM NOWHERE ELSE, which is the whole difference between it and the economy a table rejected on 09/09/2026; a starting meeple would make the bonus ambient again and would be exactly the passenger this list exists to prevent. Then the six coin leaves pinned OFF (rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard 0, coinSupplyPerPlayer 0, coinPaysBuild, coinPaysSuitCost, coinPaysGrow and coinGrowOnFullBuilding all false), and the four meeple leaves: deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1 and meepleSpendDistinctColours false. ⚠️ ON deliveryMeepleSpace's null: it does NOT mean 'no meeples', it means defer to the existing meeplesPerTile seeding, so pinning it to 1 is a real change and not a re-statement. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against the control on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. ⚠️ AS OF COMMIT e5aea08 ALL TEN NEW LEAVES ARE INERT: they exist in the data layer and no branch of play reads them yet, so this arm currently measures identically to its control. A run before the engine slices land proves the file parses and validates, and nothing else. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay sets its own meeple leaves and keeps them, and pins the two new leaves BY NAME at their off values (deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0), so it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the coins arm's two sinks, the Village Store, the balloons and the Aerodrome and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace, rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.dairyGrowsBuilt were removed with the delivery spaces and the Dairy board's Grow. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
